query: SELECT topology,vertex_index,x,y,z FROM semio_mesh_primitive JOIN semio_mesh_index ON semio_mesh_index.primitive_id=semio_mesh_primitive.id JOIN semio_mesh_position ON semio_mesh_index.primitive_id=semio_mesh_position.primitive_id AND semio_mesh_index.vertex_index=semio_mesh_position.ordinal ORDER BY semio_mesh_primitive.ordinal,semio_mesh_index.ordinal
materialTextureQuery: SELECT b.native_id AS baseColorTexture, m.native_id AS metallicRoughnessTexture, n.native_id AS normalTexture, o.native_id AS occlusionTexture, e.native_id AS emissiveTexture FROM semio_mesh_material JOIN semio_mesh_texture b ON b.native_id=base_color_texture_native_id JOIN semio_mesh_texture m ON m.native_id=metallic_roughness_texture_native_id JOIN semio_mesh_texture n ON n.native_id=normal_texture_native_id JOIN semio_mesh_texture o ON o.native_id=occlusion_texture_native_id JOIN semio_mesh_texture e ON e.native_id=emissive_texture_native_id
